name: Clean It or Replace It? Judging Carpet Honestly
title-tag: Clean or Replace Carpet? An Honest Test | Cottage Lake
meta-description: Dirt cleans up; matting and dead pad never do. The hot-water-extraction test that tells you which carpet you own — before you spend on new. Honest math inside.
post-summary: March 18, 2027 · Dirt, matting and pad failure all get called "old carpet," and they have opposite answers. One professional hot-water extraction is the cheapest diagnostic there is: what the carpet does in the month after tells you whether to clean, restretch or replace. How to read the symptoms, and the honest money math both ways.
